title: Jesse Minter: Lamar Jackson could "potentially" return to practice this week

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jesse Minter: Lamar Jackson could "potentially" return to practice this week
sources.description: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson has missed two games with an ankle injury and head coach Jesse Minter didn't offer much clarity about his chances of returning for Week 7 during a Monday press conference.
